snapshots.description: Explosion: creates powerful explosions capable of knocking people off their feet.
Ability Gauging: gauges the power levels of others via touch. Readings are accurate but not precise, rounded to the nearest whole number (e.g. 3.6 read as 4.0, 5.4 read as 5).
Combat-focused ability that seems to augment physical strength.
Fortify: increases her strength, defense and speed. Once boosted, strong enough to rip a chunk out of the road and hurl it.
Fortify: increases her strength, defense and speed. Once boosted, strong enough to rip a chunk out of the road and hurl it.
Unknown ability.
Energy Conduit: restrains opponents, heals injuries, transfers energy between another person and herself, and can exorcise certain foreign auras. Offers little combat boost.
Unknown ability; level possibly between 3.5 and 4.1.
Unknown ability.
Rock Arm: turns his arms into hardened stone.
Arcane Shot: long-range projectile ability that shoots a beam of energy from her hands, similar to Lazor.
Capacité non spécifiée, aucune information détaillée sur une capacité particulière.
Protector: creates a force field to defend against attacks, similar to Barrier.

Botanist: manifests plant growth to painfully ensnare opponents; hard to damage at his level. Converted Abilities – Flame Claw: flaming claws that slash and burn; Lightning: emits electricity for lethal blows (weaker than Remi's); Regeneration: implied.
Unknown ability.
Quick Strike: attacks more rapidly than the average person.

Botanist: manifests plant growth to painfully ensnare opponents; hard to damage at his level. Converted Abilities – Flame Claw: flaming claws that slash and burn; Lightning: emits electricity for lethal blows (weaker than Remi's); Regeneration: implied.

Channel Master (presumed): copies abilities, more advanced than John's Aura Manipulation, and keeps access to copied abilities after powering down. Copied: X-Ray Vision (sees objects and people through solid matter); Landscaping (moves earth, possibly a generalized telekinesis).

Duplication: creates and manipulates clones of herself (at least 3) that replicate her appearance and ability; also augmented with strength and speed. Converted Ability – Spectral Claw: transforms one arm into a monstrous, enlarged, purple, slime-covered state with immense strength, usable by her clones too.
Conjure: Vines: creates and manipulates vines of energy to tie up foes or turn them into long dagger-like projectiles that pierce.
Conjure: Vines: creates and manipulates vines of energy to tie up foes or turn them into long dagger-like projectiles that pierce.
Contact Shred: inflicts shredding injuries by touching the body part he wants to injure, discharging his aura into it, then letting go. Less effective against significantly stronger opponents.
Contact Shred: inflicts shredding injuries by touching the body part he wants to injure, discharging his aura into it, then letting go. Less effective against significantly stronger opponents.
Clairvoyance: sees visions of the future. It cannot be willfully activated and triggers at random times, mostly involving people she interacts with daily.
Dizzy Punch: inflicts dizziness on opponents after punching them. Not very strong physically, unlike most augmentation abilities.
Imprison: conjures a cage within the target to trap them; so far only high-tiers have broken free.
Unnamed telepathy ability: links his voice with a person he touches to speak telepathically with them from a certain distance.

Azure Storm: creates and manipulates powerful winds, including a tornado around herself to keep opponents away and a concentrated wall of wind to knock them back. Converted Ability – Flame Claw: turns her fingernails into flaming claws, greatly boosting power and speed in melee. Fire Tornado: combines both to create a large tornado of fire.
Strong Punch: punches hard enough to leave a hole in a wall without damaging his own fists. When activated, his hand and eyes glow green.
Nightmare: intimidates people and, at full throttle, traps them in make-believe worlds of pure horror.
Unknown ability.
Healing: heals and detects wounds.
Healing: heals and detects wounds.
Hand Blade: transforms her hand into a long sharp blade, much like Demon Claw.
Illumination: generates a bright, white light from her hands. Very limited combat use, but can disorient people by shining the light in their eyes.
Shadow Flame: charges up and throws up to two energy flames at a time.

Hypnosis: commands people to follow her orders without taking control of their body. Converted Abilities – Flame Claw: flaming claws that slash and burn; Lightning: emits electricity for lethal blows; Regeneration: fully recovers from critical injuries.
Unknown ability.

Hypnosis: commands people to follow her orders without taking control of their body. Converted Abilities – Flame Claw: flaming claws that slash and burn; Lightning: emits electricity for lethal blows; Regeneration: fully recovers from critical injuries.
Stone Skin: hardens his skin at will, making him stronger and more durable. Also grants a considerable speed boost and increased weight.
Implied augmentation ability, activated while punching.
Super Strength: greatly damages anything hit by his fists and lets him hurl objects at great speed.
Super Strength: greatly damages anything hit by his fists and lets him hurl objects at great speed.
Unnamed speed-related ability.
Catch Up: closes the distance between him and his opponent at a fast pace, very similar to Speed.
Unknown ability, implied to be close-ranged.
Heat Palm: heats up his palms to burn things, strong enough to painfully burn human flesh. He appears to be resistant to his own ability.
Unnamed augmentation ability strong enough to break down doors and crush someone's neck.
Strength: increases her physical strength; her strikes can make opponents cough up blood.
Iron Knuckle: increases his physical strength and durability, enhancing his melee combat.
Channel Master: effects unknown, strongly implied to be aura-related, much like Aura Manipulation.
Umbral Shift: melts into the ground, travels within it and reforms to surprise opponents.
Unnamed augmentation ability that greatly increases his strength.
Psychopomp (speculative name): makes his hand flare up with his signature-coloured aura, increasing his strength enough to easily perforate his victims.
Unknown ability.
Capacité non spécifiée, aucune information détaillée sur une capacité particulière.
Flash Forward: sees a few seconds into the future, letting her make the best immediate decision.
Phantom Push: emits hand-shaped projectiles that push opponents away.
Particles: creates and controls swarms of energy particles, forming weapons and hands to attack.
Teleportation: teleports from one place to another, bringing up to 2 people he is touching. Costs energy depending on distance and number of people; overexertion could prove fatal.
Minefield: turns a large area around himself into a battlefield where he can detonate the ground at will; also has sensory and gauging properties and enhances his physical strength.
Hair Growth: controls her hair as extra appendages and makes it grow longer for added range.
Heavy-hitter: deals powerful blows to injure foes, much like Strength or Strong Punch.
Memory Recall: forcibly makes others relive certain memories; effective even on people of much higher level. A rare ability.
Barrage: unleashes a fast flurry of punches that is notably hard to block.

Portals: creates portals to pass through like teleportation, either horizontally to come up through the ground or vertically to run through them. Converted ability – Spectral Claw: transforms one of his arms into a monstrous, purple, slime-covered limb of immense strength. Confirmed high-tier.
Armor Suit: augments his torso with a metallic substance (unclear if it extends to his legs).
Lazor: charges and shoots a lime-green laser beam strong enough to damage a wall or leave a bloody wound on an opponent.
Unknown ability, boosted by the Ability Amplifiers supplied by Brims; glows with a red aura when active.

Blademaster: conjures multiple energy blades of varying lengths (at least ten at a time): long ones for melee, short ones as throwing knives. Can fuse two katanas into a greatsword for more damage. Appears to have a quick-attack.

Tremor: creates localized earthquakes beneath his feet and controls their magnitude at will, strong enough to crack the ground and shake nearby buildings. Has some directional control over the tremors.
Fleetstep: substantially increases her speed and quickness, enhancing her melee combat.
Time Manipulation: lets her surpass opponents in speed and strength, even under the Ability Dampener; also used to help critically injured people stave off death until help arrives.

Conjure: Disks: creates and manipulates large flying disks that move quickly and can attack, defend and serve as hoverboards. They stay effective even when cracked. Under amplifiers he could generate 5 at once.

Conjure: Disks: creates and manipulates large flying disks that move quickly and can attack, defend and serve as hoverboards. They stay effective even when cracked. Under amplifiers he could generate 5 at once.
Grenadier: charges a destructive ball of condensed energy in her hand (magenta, likely her signature colour).

Hydrofreeze: creates and manipulates water (e.g. trapping targets in a bubble to drown them), shapeshifts into water to travel through pipes, and freezes water into ice to restrain foes or form icicle weapons. Converted Ability – Spectral Claw: transforms one arm into a monstrous, enlarged, purple, slime-covered state with immense strength.
Needles: shoots thin needles of energy out of his hands that can cut and scratch opponents. The needles are the same colour as his hands and eyes.
Unknown ability.
Wrist Spike (unconfirmed name): augmentation ability that makes spikes protrude from his wrists.
Lightning: shoots electricity out of her fingers; much weaker than her children's.
Bodybuilder (unconfirmed name): basic augmentation ability that greatly enhances his muscle mass and physical strength.
Unnamed augmentation ability that increases speed and strength.
Unknown ability.
Demon Claw: transforms her hands into monstrous razor-sharp claws that can cut, stab and wound opponents.
Impact: makes her arms glow with a lavender light and likely increases her attack.
Spectral Claw: likely creates two ethereal claws capable of lifting a person off the ground, crushing and slashing; also grants enhanced speed to extend the claws' reach.
Charge: appears to be a strength and speed enhancement ability.
Repulsion: uses kinetic energy to violently repel foes at close range.
Heal Link: emits a rope-like aura that heals anybody it touches.
Not explicitly stated; probably some kind of Lie Detection ability.
Time Manipulation: freezes time around people, making them unable to move.
Catalyst Ray: projectile generation ability, a form of ray functionally similar to Lazor.
Command: brainwashing that forces targets to do what he says in a trance-like state.
Superhuman: boosts his power, speed, defense and recovery to superhuman levels.
Archer: long-range projectile ability used for sniping, able to hit erratically moving targets from long distances.
Archer: long-range projectile ability used for sniping, able to hit erratically moving targets from long distances.
Lightning: generates electricity; likely can detect electrical circuitry and run at high speeds with the ability active; powerful enough to pierce Arlo's Barrier.
Ground Pound: performs a powerful slamming attack on the ground.
Unknown ability.
Capacité non spécifiée, aucune information détaillée sur une capacité particulière.
Missiles: shoots long-ranged, explosive projectiles out of his hands.
Unknown ability.
Medium: mental-based ability that lets her read past events; the further back the event, the longer it takes.

Psy-Blast: channels aura through the hands to fire powerful blasts of psychic energy (fingers on temple to concentrate, palm to release), with considerable but limited range. Converted Ability – Flame Claw: turns his fingernails into flaming claws, greatly boosting power and speed in melee.
Vigor: seemingly grants enhanced strength.
Likely a stealth-related ability.
Strong Kick: physically enhances the bottom of his leg, letting him deal massive damage with his kicks.
Demon Blade: extrudes blades from each of her arms.
Sensory Control: takes away someone's senses, trapping them in a dark haze, and manipulates their sense of pain (amplifying or nullifying it).
Regeneration: fast-acting healing potent enough to regenerate broken bones, letting him re-enter a fight within seconds. Also seems to slightly increase defense and power.

Paralysis: immobilizes up to 4 high-tier targets, even higher-level ones, with a glare. Converted Ability – Regeneration: heals his injuries at an accelerated rate, though some (e.g. to his eye) may be beyond it.
Ability not yet showcased.
Healing: one of the most powerful healers ever seen, able to fully restore several seriously injured people at once within seconds. Converted ability – Spectral Claw.
Troll is a very effective ability that lets the user masterfully manipulate the plot.

Barrier: a stronger variant of Arlo's, forming nigh-indestructible walls, jagged crystal-like barriers to protect or squeeze opponents, and cages that can slam into enemies. Converted Ability – Flame Claw: as Volcan, engulfs her hand in a claw-shaped fire that slashes and burns.
Royal Guard: dons a crimson suit of armor that greatly increases his durability and boosts his strength and speed.
Telekinesis: flings or restrains people with his mind; strong enough to stop John's Rampage.
Whirlwind: generates spinning funnels of wind from his hands to send opponents flying.
Demolition: destroys things in his path at both short and long range.

Barrier: a stronger variant of Arlo's, forming nigh-indestructible walls, jagged crystal-like barriers to protect or squeeze opponents, and cages that can slam into enemies. Converted Ability – Flame Claw: as Volcan, engulfs her hand in a claw-shaped fire that slashes and burns.
Shockwave: shoots powerful waves of force, usable as projectiles or to propel himself to evade.
Shockwave: shoots powerful waves of force, usable as projectiles or to propel himself to evade.
Phantom Fist: punches objects from a great distance without physical contact, much like Phantom Push.
Speed: moves faster than the eye can perceive, giving the element of surprise, stronger attacks and easier evasion. Surrounds her body in an aura (red at debut, later her signature yellow).
No ability (Cripple).
Charge Shot: with focus, fires a wide beam from one palm. It is not inescapable and can be blocked.
Clobber: brutally strikes an opponent, inflicting great physical damage. Her arms glow blue when used.
Unknown ability.

Phase Shift: shifts his stats between two forms. Offensive Form: sacrifices defense and recovery for higher power and speed. Defensive Form: turns his skin blue and raises defense and recovery (similar to Stone Skin) at the cost of power and speed. Has other forms not yet shown.

Phase Shift: shifts his stats between two forms. Offensive Form: sacrifices defense and recovery for higher power and speed. Defensive Form: turns his skin blue and raises defense and recovery (similar to Stone Skin) at the cost of power and speed. Has other forms not yet shown.
Crescent Slash: fires blue moon-shaped projectiles from his hands, sharp enough to cut human flesh.
